$comment: Provider pack: Chrome DevTools MCP server for frontend agents. Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when --enable-pack chrome-devtools (v2 shape: mcp.servers.<name>.disabled:false + permissions array rule). Privacy flags (no telemetry, no CrUX, isolated profile) are baked into the source opencode.json command array, so this pack only flips disabled + appends the permissions allow. Requires Chrome stable installed locally.
